author: imryaan
body:
I'd just like to say this server has just too much lag now, you cant even place a block without being teleported back or falling through it. 

You get these weird flying nametags around you make you change hotbar slot.

You sometimes end up with this weird flying glitch which makes you fly up and then go back down to the ground (Zegita has a video of this) 

I donate money to this server like many other people but there is still lag. why?
